verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.mixpanel.com returning HTTP 200 with a structured index of .md doc links. Mixpanel also publishes a dedicated "Docs for AI Agents" page that lists downloadable OpenAPI specs, and the same list appears in llms.txt, so agents have purpose-built entry points. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.mixpanel.com/llms.txt # Mixpanel
The same list appears under "## OpenAPI Specs" in the docs llms.txt.
Every Mixpanel API is described by an OpenAPI specification. Use these to generate client code, validate requests
